old_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of a snowy landscape under an overcast sky. The ground is blanketed in snow, and sparse bushes dot the terrain. A man stands in the center of the frame, dressed in winter clothing, including a green jacket and sunglasses, suggesting cold weather conditions. He appears to be observing his surroundings or preparing for an activity. As the scene progresses, there is a sudden explosion, creating a visible plume of smoke and debris. The man is no longer visible after frame 13. The camera remains static, capturing the entire event without any noticeable movement or change in angle. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet anticipation followed by a dramatic burst of action.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a wide shot of a snowy landscape under an overcast sky. The ground is blanketed in snow, and sparse bushes dot the terrain. A man stands in the center of the frame, dressed in winter clothing, including a green jacket and sunglasses, suggesting cold weather conditions. He appears to be observing his surroundings or preparing for an activity. As the scene progresses, there is a sudden explosion in the distance, sending a plume of smoke and debris into the air. The explosion occurs off-screen but is clearly visible due to the dust cloud it creates. The man remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining his position in the snowy field. The camera remains static, capturing the entire event without any noticeable movement or change in angle. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet anticipation followed by a dramatic burst of action.
caption: A man in a dark hooded jacket, sunglasses, and black gloves stands in a snow-covered field dotted with dry bushes. He faces the camera from the middle ground while the overcast purple sky and distant horizon remain fixed. His posture shifts only slightly, and the foreground bushes do not move across the still frame. The view then changes abruptly to the same empty field, with the man no longer present and the framing unchanged. A brief bright flash appears among the middle-distance bushes before the eruption. A grayish cloud of dust and snow erupts at that exact spot. The plume rises and expands steadily, forming a rounded, billowing column above the source area. Its base remains at the ground while the upper mass grows taller and wider. The surrounding snowy landscape and bushes stay still as the single cloud continues to drift upward.

Audit this candidate caption against the actual chronological images, and correct factual errors.
This is a TEMPORALLY CROPPED EXCERPT from a longer video, not a complete event or a loop.
The first view may already be mid-action; the last view need not contain completion. Different
endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.
Do not shorten a rich caption into a terse technical checklist. Avoid annotation phrases such as
'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.

Return JSON {"decision":"keep|edit", "issues":[{"quote":"exact span in candidate caption",
"problem":"concrete visual mismatch or unsupported assertion"}], "caption":"complete final caption",
"length_note":"empty unless required"}. Keep means unchanged caption and no issues. An edit
must actually correct the cited issue. This is a fallible automatic review, not proof of correctness.
